facts.fact: Lily 第一次双人滑翔伞吓得大喊要死了，表姐 Jordan 在旁边让她放松。
facts.anchor: “Oh my God! We’re going to DIE!” Lily screamed.

facts.fact: 这次滑翔伞起因是双胞胎弟弟 Sam 的挑衅（dare），Jordan 澄清不是自己劝的。
facts.anchor: Jordan had the nerve to laugh. “Don’t blame me. Sam dared you, remember?”

facts.fact: 导游 Rebecca 的讲解在 Lily 脑中回放：Paradise 是佛罗里达礁岛群之外最大的人工私人岛屿。
facts.anchor: Paradise is the largest privately owned and operated man-made island off the Florida Keys.

facts.fact: 岛呈菱形，Bliss Bridge 横跨贯穿全岛的运河，东侧是成人别墅区 Tranquil Cove，西侧是留给未满十八岁客人的 Thrill Harbor。
facts.anchor: Bliss Bridge is the major pathway over the canal that winds through our entire diamond-shaped island.

facts.fact: 这次全包度假是奶奶 Penelope 送的圣诞惊喜礼物，Lily 连怎么称呼她都不知道，一年只见一面左右。
facts.anchor: This all-expenses-paid vacation was a surprise Christmas gift from their grandmother, Penelope.

facts.fact: Lookouts 是驻守 Thrill Harbor 的现场监护人，腰别大对讲机，介于救生员与保安之间，Lily 觉得没法在他们眼皮下放松。
facts.anchor: Lookouts were on-site chaperones stationed around Thrill Harbor with large walkie-talkies on their belts.

facts.fact: Jordan 坦白全家要搬去温哥华，说父母只说要 a fresh start，她一直气到说不出口。
facts.anchor: “No, I’m not okay,” Jordan snapped. “We’re moving. To Vancouver, of all places.”

facts.fact: Sam 提议立誓把这次假期过成最棒的，用吐口水握手封誓——呼应几年前尼亚加拉瀑布附近鬼屋酒店找鬼的旧约，最后鬼只是只松鼠。
facts.anchor: “It’s a spit-shake. To seal the pact,” he explained.
